title: Hidha Mootummaa Cabse
intro: Biyya lageen yaa’an, iddoowwan biqiltuu magariisaa lamaa fi badhaadhina gita hin qabne — jiraattonni ishee garuu Isa isaan eebbise sanaaf xiyyeeffannaa dhabanii guddatan. Yaadannoowwan deebisee isaan waamu yeroo dhufan ofirraa garagalan. Wanti itti aanee dhufe adabbii ammallee akka akeekkachiisaatti sagalee dhageessisaa jiru ture. Hawaasni durii kun eenyu ture?
clues: Lafa baayʼee eebbifamte keessa waan jiraattuuf, manni keenya iddoowwan biqiltuu magariisa lama gidduutti argama ture.
Laggeen lafa keenya keessa yaaʼanii fi midhaan baayʼee mana keenya guututti gammadneerra.
Ta’us gara galateeffannaa fi Gooftaa keenyaaf ajajamuutti yeroo waamamnu of tuuluun garagalle.
Qabeenyi fi salphinni keenya Isa hunda kenne akka dagannu nu taasise.
Achiis bishaan akka tasaa danqaa guddaa nuti itti hirkanne sana cabsee dhufe.
Nuti ummata Saba', kan lafti isaa Hidha Ma'riib guddichaan beekamtudha.

outcome.label: Hiree Keenya
options: Iddoowwan biqiltuu hadhaaʼoon lama kanneen lalisaa keenya bakka buʼan
Iddoowwan biqiltuu keenya caalaatti lalisaa taʼan
Sabni keenya gosa kudha lamatti qoodame
outcome.answer: Iddoowwan biqiltuu hadhaaʼoon lama kanneen lalisaa keenya bakka buʼan

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
